newsitem.title: USA: MBIA qualifies 21 muni bond issues for insurance.
newsitem.headline: MBIA qualifies 21 muni bond issues for insurance.

text.p: MBIA Insurance Corp said Tuesday it qualified for bond insurance the following 21 municipal bond issues slated for competitive sale today.
--San Francisco, Calif., $145 million water revenue bonds.
--Regional School District No 19, Conn., $5 million general obligation bonds.
--Bettendorf, Iowa, $1.31 million GO and refunding bonds.
--Bettendorf, Iowa, $1.63 million GO and refunding bonds.
--Indianola, Iowa, $3.41 million water revenue bonds.
--Lakeland School District No 272, Idaho, $8.6 million general obligation bonds.
--East Bridgewater, Mass., $14.405 million GOs.
--Carroll County, Md., $21 million improvement bonds.
--Burke County, Fla., $2 million GOs.
--Burke County, Fla., $18.765 million GO and refunding bonds.
--Fayettevile, N.C., $16.5 million GOs.
--Stokes County, N.C., $8 million GOs.
--Campbell-Savona Central School District, N.Y., $3.4 million GOs.
--Westhill Central School District, N.Y., $4.2 million GO school bonds.
--Pittsburgh, Pa., $167.44 million GO and refunding bonds, under MBIA's alternate bidding program.
--Pottsgrove School District, Pa., $4.995 million GOs, under MBIA's alternate biddgin program.
--Franklin County, Tenn., $14 million school bonds.
--Denton County, Texas, $1.48 million improvement bonds.
--Harris County Municipal Utility District No 10, Texas, $2.09 million waterworks and sewer bonds.
--Texas $50 million taxable veterans bonds.
--St Francis, Wis., $1.33 million GO notes.
--U.S. Municipal Desk, 212-859-1650
